automatic_calculation: OOXML calcMode omitted (automatic); every sample additionally forced through hard recalculation
caveat: LibreOffice Calc recalculation of original XLSX formulas; not Microsoft Excel-native RAND sequence reproduction
frozen_values: D1:D160 read from exported cached XML, immediately copied to immutable values.json before inference
recalculation: .uno:CalculateHard before every export; wait for LOK_CALLBACK_UNO_COMMAND_RESULT success=true
rng_state: Never set, serialized or exposed to predictor; frozen C values remain scorer-only

source_audit.inference_consequence: Under independent continuous RAND draws, each hidden target location is exchangeable, conditional on the visible values. No positional method can systematically beat 1/unknown_count without extra information.
source_audit.limits: Formula inspection does not certify PRNG independence or equivalence of spreadsheet engines. Finite RAND ties must be rejected, never silently repaired.

logical_reshape.order: D1..D160 row-major, explicitly requested; differs from print layout
